verdicts.reason: A keeps the sun logo and SOLSTICE wordmark legible and in proportion. Its flaws: the headline and CTA stack is jammed against the top and bottom edges of the banner, a big dead gap sits in the middle, and bokeh dots touch 'Light' and fall just under the CTA. B has a strong left-to-right headline, but it shrinks the logo to an unreadable speck, which breaks the brand. It also wraps the CTA awkwardly onto two lines and lets a bokeh dot collide with 'Line'.
